description: Source code for the class 'BundleDataTargetGenerator' which manages the generation of bundle data targets in a build system, including setting output types, filling sources and outputs, and validating substitutions.

classes.name: BundleDataTargetGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and validating bundle data targets within the build system.

methods.name: BundleDataTargetGenerator::DoRun
methods.description: Main execution method that sets target type, fills sources, outputs, product type, and performs validation.

methods.name: BundleDataTargetGenerator::FillOutputs
methods.description: Parses and validates the outputs for the bundle data target, ensuring substitutions are valid and within the bundle directory.

methods.name: BundleDataTargetGenerator::FillProductType
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the product type for the bundle data target.

methods.name: BundleDataTargetGenerator::EnsureSubstitutionIsInBundleDir
methods.description: Checks if a substitution pattern is within the bundle directory, setting an error if not.
